{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
# This will catch any non-numeric values (though none seem present)
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
conversion_errors = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

# Verify that 'LOYAL' exists in customer_segment
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Verify that 'completed' exists in status
completed_exists = 'completed' in df['status'].unique()

# Check that there are no unexpected non-numeric values in revenue
# (just to be safe)
invalid_revenue = df[df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.]', na=False)]

conversion_errors, loyal_exists, completed_exists, invalid_revenue"}
